posts.title: Review: Savage Hunter (a Savage Worlds Supplement)
Savage Hunter - Fan Maps
posts.description: Hey, everyone! I've started playing and learning Savage Worlds with Savage Hunter , a third party project based on the Monster Hunter franchise. I'm really loving the game and decided to create some maps for it. In case it helps anyone else, I've put them on Itch for free .
